name: Diff Checker
tagline: Find differences between two texts line by line
description: Compare two texts and see exactly what changed: added lines, removed lines, and unchanged context. Uses unified diff format. Perfect for comparing code versions, document revisions, or configuration files.

expert_defs.name: diff_checker_compare
expert_defs.description: Computes unified diff between two text inputs. Params: text_a (original text), text_b (modified text), context_lines (lines of context around changes, default 3). Returns JSON with output_type text containing the unified diff.
code: diff = list(difflib.unified_diff(lines_a, lines_b, fromfile='Original (A)', tofile='Modified (B)', n=int(context_lines)))
result = '(no differences found — texts are identical)'

conceptTexts: Plugin: Diff Checker (id: diff-checker). Expert diff_checker_compare computes unified diff between two texts. Params: text_a (original), text_b (modified), context_lines (0-10, default 3). Returns {output_type: 'text', data: '<unified diff or no differences message>'}.
